title: Where are you from?
subtitle: Elif meets Sam at his café
canDo: I can say where people are from.
I can use he, she and it.
I can name some countries and nationalities.
teacherNotes: Warm-up: Dünya haritası paylaşın; öğrenciler kendi ülkelerini ve şehirlerini göstersin.
Türk öğrenciler he/she karıştırır (Türkçede tek "o"). Her yanlışta nazikçe "he or she?" diye sorun.
Arap öğrenciler şehir/ülke için she kullanabilir (مدينة → هي). "It's a big city" örneğini vurgulayın.
Ülke–milliyet eşleştirmesinde öğrencilerin kendi ülkelerini de ekleyin (Syrian, Iraqi, Egyptian…).

prompts: What's the name of your city?

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: My new class
sections.intro: Elif writes about the people in her class.
paragraphs: This is my English class in Boston.
It's a very big city in Brazil.
I'm Turkish, and I'm very happy here!

sections.title: Grammar: he / she / it + is
rules: **it** = a thing, a place or an animal
examples: Omar is from Jordan. He's Jordanian.
Maya is American. She's from Boston.
Amman is in Jordan. It's a big city.

support.tr: Türkçede tek bir "o" var; İngilizcede üç tane: he (erkek), she (kadın), it (eşya, yer, hayvan). Üçüyle de is kullanılır: He is from Jordan = O Ürdünlü. Konuşurken kısaltırız: he's, she's, it's. Soru: Where is he from? = O nereli?
support.ar: في الإنجليزية: he = هو (للمذكّر)، she = هي (للمؤنّث)، it للأشياء والأماكن والحيوانات. نستخدم is مع الثلاثة: He is from Jordan = هو من الأردن. وفي الكلام نختصر: he's و she's و it's. والسؤال: Where is he from? = من أين هو؟

tr.note: Türkçedeki "o" için doğru kelimeyi seç: erkek için he, kadın için she. Bu çok sık yapılan bir hata!
wrong: Maya is my teacher. He's American.
Omar is my classmate. She's from Jordan.
right: Maya is my teacher. She's American.
Omar is my classmate. He's from Jordan.

ar.note: في العربية نقول عن المدينة «هي»، لكن في الإنجليزية نستخدم it للأماكن والأشياء.
wrong: Amman is in Jordan. She's a big city.
Boston? He is a nice city.
right: Amman is in Jordan. It's a big city.

sections.title: Practice

support.tr: He, She veya It ile tamamla.
support.ar: أكمل بـ He أو She أو It.
